task: research programme codesign-cant, milestone 7h: thrust-to-weight as a design variable, scored at twice the trained lever
errors: First full run started with run_in_background and the default 30-minute background limit; it was stopped about 75% through with nothing saved (Pool.map returns only at the end). Rerun with per-run checkpoints and timeout 7200000: 2241 s.

doc_friction.issue: Says to start multi-minute jobs with run_in_background but not that the background limit defaults to 30 minutes; a ~40-minute CMA-ES sweep was killed and lost ~30 minutes of compute. Worth one line: pass timeout up to 7200000 and checkpoint per job.
pick_track.py's suggested next step (score at 30 degrees, from the paper LOG entry) and the 7g LOG's next step (thrust-to-weight free) differ; I took 7g's as the substantive one.

deviations.why: A smoke run showed the planned retrofit levels 2.5 and 3.0 make the sizing closure run away for most designs
deviations.did: Changed the retrofit arm to 'largest thrust-to-weight that closes' before any held-out run, and recorded the change and its reason in the predictions entry
deviations.result: Arm well-defined for all 12 designs; finding about the mass spiral became part of the headline

notes: Verification: research/codesign-cant tests 45 passed 1 skipped (python3.13, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; programme_check ok; check_post_frontmatter and check_post_links ok. pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a researcher writing the variant, predictions, a 40-minute sweep, analysis and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
